title: Something the reader knows
instructions: Read the sentence, then choose the option that fits.

parts.prompt: ___ sun was hidden by clouds, so the photograph looked dark.

choice_rationales.A: There is only one sun, so the reader knows which one is meant.
choice_rationales.B: A would suggest one of many suns.
choice_rationales.C: An comes before a vowel sound, and it would also suggest one of many.
choice_rationales.D: Some would suggest an amount of sun, which does not fit a single object here.

parts.hint: How many suns can the writer mean?
parts.correct_explanation: The sun is unique, so it takes the.
